quests.instruction: What is the action word for using your teeth to break up food in your mouth?
quests.question: Chew
quests.hint: Think about what you do to food before you swallow it.
quests.explanation: Chew means to use your teeth to break food into small pieces. We chew our food before we swallow!
quests.funFact: Chewing your food well helps your tummy digest it more easily!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for moving food or drink down your throat?
quests.question: Swallow
quests.hint: Think about what happens right after you chew your food.
quests.explanation: Swallow means to move food or drink down your throat. We swallow after we chew!
quests.funFact: Food travels down a special tube to your tummy when you swallow!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for breathing in quickly through your nose to smell something?
quests.question: Sniff
quests.hint: Think about short little breaths through your nose near a flower.
quests.explanation: Sniff means to breathe in quickly through your nose. Dogs sniff to find yummy smells!
quests.funFact: A dog's nose is so powerful it can sniff out smells from far away!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for speaking very softly and quietly?
quests.question: Whisper
quests.hint: Think about how quiet your voice gets when sharing a secret.
quests.explanation: Whisper means to speak very softly and quietly. We whisper in the library!
quests.funFact: Whispering is a gentle way to talk without making the room noisy!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for using a loud voice to call out?
quests.question: Shout
quests.hint: Think about how loud your voice gets when you call a friend far away.
quests.explanation: Shout means to use a very loud voice. We shout to call someone from far away!
quests.funFact: Shouting outside is great, but inside our voices should stay soft!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for making a musical sound by blowing air through your lips?
quests.question: Whistle
quests.hint: Think about the tune you make by pushing air through tiny round lips.
quests.explanation: Whistle means to make a musical sound by blowing air through your lips. Some birds whistle too!
quests.funFact: Some birds can whistle beautiful tunes just like people!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for making a soft musical sound with your mouth closed?
quests.question: Hum
quests.hint: Think about singing a tune without opening your lips.
quests.explanation: Hum means to sing a tune with your mouth closed. We hum our favorite songs quietly!
quests.funFact: Humming can be a calm and happy way to enjoy a tune anywhere!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for laughing in a soft, quick, happy way?
quests.question: Giggle
quests.hint: Think about the little laugh you make at something silly and cute.
quests.explanation: Giggle means to laugh softly and quickly. We giggle at something funny or silly!
quests.funFact: A giggle is a small laugh that often leads to a bigger one!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for turning down the corners of your mouth when you feel unhappy?
quests.question: Frown
quests.hint: Think about the opposite of a smile.
quests.explanation: Frown means to turn your mouth down when you feel unhappy. It is okay to frown sometimes!
quests.funFact: Talking about your feelings can help turn a frown back into a smile!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for bending your body forward to show respect?
quests.question: Bow
quests.hint: Think about what a performer does after a great show.
quests.explanation: Bow means to bend your body forward to show respect or thanks. Dancers bow after a show!
quests.funFact: In many countries, people bow to say hello or thank you!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for moving your body with small, quick side-to-side movements?
quests.question: Wiggle
quests.hint: Think about how a worm moves without any legs.
quests.explanation: Wiggle means to move with small, quick side-to-side movements. We wiggle our fingers and toes!
quests.funFact: Worms wiggle to move because they do not have any legs!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for pressing something firmly from different sides?
quests.question: Squeeze
quests.hint: Think about what you do to a sponge to push the water out.
quests.explanation: Squeeze means to press something firmly. We squeeze a sponge to push water out!
quests.funFact: Squeezing a soft toy can help your hands feel busy and calm!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for quickly taking hold of something with your hand?
quests.question: Grab
quests.hint: Think about quickly picking up your favorite toy.
quests.explanation: Grab means to quickly take hold of something. We grab our bags before we leave!
quests.funFact: Grabbing things quickly takes fast hands and sharp eyes!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for keeping something in your hands without letting go?
quests.question: Hold
quests.hint: Think about what you do with someone's hand when you cross the street together.
quests.explanation: Hold means to keep something in your hands. We hold hands when we cross the street!
quests.funFact: Holding hands with someone is a warm way to feel safe together!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for hitting something gently and quickly?
quests.question: Tap
quests.hint: Think about lightly hitting a drum with one finger.
quests.explanation: Tap means to hit something gently and quickly. We tap on a door before we open it!
quests.funFact: Tapping your foot to music is a fun way to keep the beat!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for making a quick, sharp sound with your fingers?
quests.question: Snap
quests.hint: Think about rubbing your thumb and finger together to make a click.
quests.explanation: Snap means to make a quick, sharp sound with your fingers. We snap to the beat of a song!
quests.funFact: Snapping your fingers takes lots of practice to get it just right!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for using a broom to clean dust and dirt off the floor?
quests.question: Sweep
quests.hint: Think about what you do with a broom after a messy craft project.
quests.explanation: Sweep means to use a broom to clean the floor. We sweep up crumbs after a snack!
quests.funFact: Sweeping the floor is a great way to help keep a home tidy!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for cleaning a floor with a wet, soapy tool?
quests.question: Mop
quests.hint: Think about cleaning up a spill with a long-handled tool and soapy water.
quests.explanation: Mop means to clean a floor using a wet, soapy tool. We mop up spills!
quests.funFact: A mop uses soap and water to make floors clean and shiny!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for wiping tiny dirt particles off furniture?
quests.question: Dust
quests.hint: Think about wiping a cloth across a shelf to make it shine.
quests.explanation: Dust means to wipe away tiny bits of dirt. We dust the shelves to keep them clean!
quests.funFact: Dusting regularly helps keep a room looking fresh and tidy!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for bending cloth or paper neatly to make it smaller?
quests.question: Fold
quests.hint: Think about what you do with clean laundry before it goes in a drawer.
quests.explanation: Fold means to bend something neatly to make it smaller. We fold our clean clothes!
quests.funFact: Folding paper again and again is how you make an origami shape!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for putting something up so it does not touch the ground?
quests.question: Hang
quests.hint: Think about what you do with your coat on a hook.
quests.explanation: Hang means to put something up so it stays off the ground. We hang our coats on hooks!
quests.funFact: Hanging up clothes keeps them neat and free of wrinkles!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for looping laces or string to make a knot?
quests.question: Tie
quests.hint: Think about what you do with the laces on your sneakers.
quests.explanation: Tie means to loop string or laces to make a knot. We tie our shoes before we go outside!
quests.funFact: Learning to tie your shoes is a big step for young children!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for closing your clothes using small round fasteners?
quests.question: Button
quests.hint: Think about what you do to close up a shirt or coat.
quests.explanation: Button means to close clothing using small round fasteners. We button our coats in winter!
quests.funFact: Buttons come in many shapes, sizes, and colors!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for closing something using a sliding fastener?
quests.question: Zip
quests.hint: Think about what you do to close your jacket or your backpack.
quests.explanation: Zip means to close something using a sliding fastener. We zip up our jackets when it's cold!
quests.funFact: A zipper has tiny teeth that lock together to keep things closed!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for putting things neatly into a bag or box?
quests.question: Pack
quests.hint: Think about what you do with your clothes before a trip.
quests.explanation: Pack means to put things neatly into a bag or box. We pack our bags before a trip!
quests.funFact: Packing a bag ahead of time helps you feel ready for an adventure!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for using a small tool to make your hair neat?
quests.question: Comb
quests.hint: Think about what you do to your hair after a bath.
quests.explanation: Comb means to use a small tool to make your hair neat. We comb our hair every morning!
quests.funFact: Combing your hair gently helps keep it smooth and tangle-free!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for washing your whole body in water?
quests.question: Bathe
quests.hint: Think about what you do in the tub before bedtime.
quests.explanation: Bathe means to wash your whole body in water. We bathe to stay clean and fresh!
quests.funFact: A warm bath can help your body feel calm before bedtime!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for putting on your clothes?
quests.question: Dress
quests.hint: Think about what you do every morning before breakfast.
quests.explanation: Dress means to put on your clothes. We dress ourselves every morning!
quests.funFact: Learning to dress yourself is an exciting skill for young children!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for having clothes or an item on your body?
quests.question: Wear
quests.hint: Think about what a hat does when it is on your head.
quests.explanation: Wear means to have something on your body, like clothes. We wear a coat when it's cold!
quests.funFact: People around the world wear many different kinds of clothing!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for running after someone or something quickly?
quests.question: Chase
quests.hint: Think about what a puppy does when it sees a rolling ball.
quests.explanation: Chase means to run after someone or something. We chase a ball rolling down a hill!
quests.funFact: Playing chase is a fun game that helps you practice running fast!
